plugin.name: IFC (BIM)
plugin.description: Opens IFC files (IFC 2x3, IFC 4, IFC 4.3) as nested groups with their IFC classes as tags, GlobalIds and property sets, and exports the model as IFC4. The IFC reader (web-ifc) is loaded on the first import.

errors.unreadable: The IFC file could not be read.
errors.noGeometry: The IFC file contains no geometry.
